report_name: Ransomware Attack Forces NY School District to Cancel Classes

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: A ransomware attack was deployed against the Oneonta City School District, encrypting data and crippling IT systems, which forced the cancellation of classes.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The use of vssadmin.exe to delete shadow copies was suggested as a hunting hint, as it is a common ransomware technique to prevent system recovery.

identities.name: Oneonta City School District
identities.description: A school district in New York that was forced to cancel classes for two days following a ransomware attack that crippled its IT systems, affecting five schools and approximately 1,700 students.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Delete Shadow Copies
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Delete Shadow Copies
id: 2b8a1b9c-7d3e-4f6a-8b1c-9d2e8f7a6b5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://dysruptionhub.com/oneonta-new-york-schools-ransomware-attack/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-23
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery, as suggested by hunting hints in the report.

indicators.name: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
id: 3c9b2c8d-8e4f-4g7b-9c2d-8e3f9a8b7c6b
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of PowerShell with encoded commands, a common technique for obfuscating and downloading malware.
references:
  - https://dysruptionhub.com/oneonta-new-york-schools-ransomware-attack/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-23
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -e '
      - ' -en '
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -enco'
      - ' -encod'
      - ' -encode'
      - ' -encoded'
      - ' -encodedc'
      - ' -encodedco'
      - ' -encodedcom'
      - ' -encodedcomm'
      - ' -encodedcomma'
      - ' -encodedcomman'
      - ' -encodedcommand'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of PowerShell with encoded commands, a common technique for obfuscating and downloading malware, as suggested by hunting hints in the report.
